title: A key added after a strip literal whose content starts with a tab and has no final line break
notes: The new key goes after the line break that ends the scalar's last line; the scalar's content, tab included, is untouched, and a final line break the input did not have stays missing (docs/edit-semantics.md, Kit conventions). The scalar is yaml-test-suite 96NN, second input. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend refused the edit as one that would not read back.
